title: AdjudicationRequested
description: Payload: a live adjudicator call was sent for one tracked spine (S9). It is refused once the run's counted cap is spent (INV-2). The cost is counted when the result arrives. The candidate set is the one a LookupResult returned.

lookupEventSeq.description: Ledger position of the LookupResult whose candidates were sent. Its candidateSetHash must equal candidateSetHash here (ledger rule).

cropHash.description: Hash of the spine crop sent. Crops persist (INV-22); frames do not.
